subject: NovusHealth pilot closeout playbook & exec RSVP
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Saul Hernandez <s.hernandez@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposed pilot plan (attachments)

Hi Saul —

Great to speak with you today. Per our call, here is a short recap and the recommended pilot / evaluation approach so your team can sign off on scope and success criteria:

Recap (30-min discovery)
- Use case: clinical documentation assistance (notes summarization + suggested edits) in Novus EMR export flow.
- Data: de-identified exports (S3 bucket) for the initial run; security team requested retention controls.
- Timeline preference: 4-week pilot with a 1-week prep window.

Proposed pilot plan (attached: Novus_POC_Plan_v1.pdf)
- Week 0: access & infra (cloud VPC peering or private tunnel; redwood private endpoint)
- Week 1: model tuning & integration test (sample export -> inference -> annotated output)
- Weeks 2–3: evaluator runs (10 clinicians, 200 notes/day) + metric capture
- Week 4: final readout, quality regression report, exec decision window

Success criteria (please confirm):
- Precision metric: > 85% clinician-accepted suggestions (per eval checklist)
- Latency: 99th pctile < 400ms for generation in our test harness
- Cost target: < $0.10 per note at pilot throughput

Next steps (action items)
1) Please confirm success criteria above or share edits (Priya / Security for data retention).
2) I’ll send the eval checklist (attached) and a draft SOW for legal.
3) Propose two exec-readout slots for final sign-off week of Sep 6.

Attachments: Novus_POC_Plan_v1.pdf, Novus_Eval_Checklist_v2.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll start the internal routing once you confirm.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Saul Hernandez <s.hernandez@novushealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@novushealth.com>, security@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-08-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed pilot plan (attachments)

Thanks Jasmine — good summary and the timeline looks achievable. A few clarifying points from our side:

- Success criteria: Priya and I are aligned on the 85% acceptance threshold but would like a secondary metric for false-positive suggestions (we'd prefer FP rate < 8%).
- Latency target acceptable at 400ms p99; please also confirm typical cold-start behavior and KV-cache expectations.
- Security: engaging our infra security team (security@novushealth.com) for the retention policy and KMS integration. They requested an evidence doc for audit logs.

Two asks for the pilot:
1) Can you add an automated sampling plan for manual review (we want to review ~5% of outputs daily)?
2) We need the draft SOW to route to procurement by Sep 3 to keep the Sep 6 readout realistic.

If you can send the SOW and the audit-evidence stub, I'll loop our legal and procurement.

—Saul
Director, Clinical Workflow Innovation
NovusHealth
